pages.text: Upgrade the hive with the mod's metals. Each tier adds speed and a module slot:$(li)Basic: 25%, 1 slot$(li)Reinforced: 35%, 2 slots$(li)Draconic: 50%, 3 slots$(li)Legendary: 75%, 4 slots
Tiers go in order: only a Draconic hive becomes Legendary. Everything inside is kept: bees, frame, flower, modules, armour.
Each tier looks the part: metal fittings on the item, metal corners on the hive on your back, and the tier's colours on the hive window.
